title: 天天准备好迎接安全检查（国内版）
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/02_Module 11 — Audit & Inspection Readiness.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/02_Module 11 — Audit & Inspection Readiness（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 小问题不改会越滚越大
points.K3: 从临时突击到日常常态
points.K4: 为多年后的调阅做准备
points.K5: 记录保存期限各不相同
points.K11: 按时回复，写明完成日期
points.K13: 成熟实验室的日常样子

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜站在整洁的实验室里，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass in a tidy laboratory and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲怎样天天准备好迎接检查。
overlay: 天天准备好迎接安全检查

shots.scene: 日历、档案夹、检查表、循环箭头四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a calendar, a file folder, a blank checklist and a circular loop arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 心态、记录、自查、整改、节奏。

shots.scene: 王老师在走廊里对阿杰说话，手里拿着空白通知
shots.prompt_en: In a hallway, the safety administrator holds a blank notice and speaks to the young male student.
shots.narration: 王老师说：明天学院来查实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰慌忙翻找一堆乱糟糟的文件夹，纸张散落
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frantically digs through a messy pile of blank folders, papers scattered on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰慌了，到处翻记录。

shots.scene: 小研从柜子里抽出一个整齐的空白档案盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calmly pulls a neat labeled-blank archive box from a cabinet.
shots.narration: 小研不慌：记录平时就整理好了。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两人中间，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the two students and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 准备好的，是平时的功夫。

shots.scene: 检查人员走进实验室，阿杰脸上冒汗
shots.prompt_en: A visitor with a blank clipboard enters the lab while the young male student sweats nervously.
shots.narration: 检查来了就慌，说明平时没准备。

shots.scene: 舞台上的彩排图标，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stage rehearsal with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 把检查当彩排，而不是正式演出。

shots.scene: 档案盒和循环日历图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an archive box and a calendar with a loop arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 管用的是平时的记录和节奏。

shots.section_title: 小问题不改会越滚越大
shots.scene: 一个小雪球滚下山坡越滚越大
shots.prompt_en: A small snowball rolling down a hill and growing bigger and bigger. No people.
shots.narration: 小问题不改，会越滚越大。
overlay: 小问题不改会越滚越大

shots.section_title: 小问题不改会越滚越大
shots.scene: 小罚单图标后面跟着一个巨大的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A small ticket icon followed by a huge warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：小违规没查根源，几年后重罚。

shots.section_title: 小问题不改会越滚越大
shots.scene: 老周在组会上指着空白整改单
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a blank corrective action form at a lab group meeting.
shots.narration: 发现问题，就要从根上改掉。

shots.section_title: 从临时突击到日常常态
shots.scene: 下降的折线图标，旁边一个慌乱奔跑的小人
shots.prompt_en: A falling line chart icon next to a small figure running in panic. No people.
shots.narration: 听说要查才突击补材料，不可取。
overlay: 从临时突击到日常常态

shots.section_title: 从临时突击到日常常态
shots.scene: 上升的折线图标，旁边一个平稳的日历
shots.prompt_en: A rising line chart icon next to a calm calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 要让实验室天天都经得起查。

shots.section_title: 从临时突击到日常常态
shots.scene: 小研每天下班前整理记录本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tidies and files a blank logbook at the end of the day.
shots.narration: 突击检查来了，也一切照常。

shots.section_title: 为多年后的调阅做准备
shots.scene: 时光沙漏和档案盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an hourglass and an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 有的记录，多年后还可能被调阅。
overlay: 为多年后的调阅做准备

shots.section_title: 为多年后的调阅做准备
shots.scene: 体检报告和接触记录图标放进保险柜
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank health check report and a blank exposure record going into a secure cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 比如接触和体检记录，要长期保存。

shots.section_title: 为多年后的调阅做准备
shots.scene: 老李在电脑前建数字档案，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets up a digital archive on a computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 今天就要建好可靠的电子档案。

shots.section_title: 记录保存期限各不相同
shots.scene: 几本厚薄不同的档案夹，旁边不同长短的时钟条
shots.prompt_en: Several blank folders of different thickness, each beside a time bar of a different length. No people.
shots.narration: 不同记录，保存期限不一样。
overlay: 记录保存期限各不相同

shots.section_title: 记录保存期限各不相同
shots.scene: 塞得乱七八糟的文件柜，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An overstuffed messy filing cabinet with papers sticking out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 乱塞的文件柜管不了这些。

shots.section_title: 记录保存期限各不相同
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白规章，指着期限表图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank regulation booklet and points at a blank retention table.
shots.narration: 期限按国家和学校规定执行。

shots.scene: 秒表图标和一个打开的电子档案图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stopwatch and an open digital folder. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：一小时调出多年前记录。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前很快调出空白记录，检查人员点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly pulls up a blank record on a computer while a visitor with a clipboard nods.
shots.narration: 要什么拿什么，显得专业可信。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验中沾到样品，小研陪他冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his gloved hand at a sink while the female graduate student stands by him.
shots.narration: 一件事，可能既是安全也是质量问题。

shots.scene: 一个放大镜分出两条箭头指向两张空白报告
shots.prompt_en: One magnifying glass icon with two arrows splitting toward two blank report forms. No people.
shots.narration: 只做一次调查，分别出两份报告。

shots.scene: 两份内容矛盾的报告图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two blank report icons with conflicting arrows between them, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 各查各的，记录会互相打架。

shots.scene: 时间轴上四个节点图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with four node icons lighting up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 自查要一层层累积起来。

shots.scene: 小研拿空白检查表在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks through the lab with a blank checklist, checking items.
shots.narration: 每周带检查表巡一遍。

shots.scene: 老周对照一本厚厚的空白规章逐项核对
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks items one by one against a thick blank regulation binder.
shots.narration: 每季度对照全部要求自查。

shots.scene: 王老师带着别的学院的老师来评估
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator brings a visitor from another department with a blank clipboard to assess the lab.
shots.narration: 定期请外面的人来看看。

shots.scene: 全组站成一排，迎接一场模拟检查
shots.prompt_en: The whole lab group lines up while the safety administrator runs a mock inspection with a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 每年来一次全面模拟检查。

shots.scene: 模拟检查后，小研把发现写在空白整改单上
shots.prompt_en: After the mock inspection, the female graduate student writes findings on a blank corrective action form.
shots.narration: 模拟查出的问题，都当真去改。

shots.scene: 缺页的档案、乱答的对话气泡、裂缝三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a folder with a missing page, a speech bubble with a scribble, and a cracked wall. No people.
shots.narration: 能暴露缺记录、乱回答和隐患。

shots.scene: 四个步骤图标连成一个圆环
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons linked in a circle: an eye, a magnifying glass, a wrench and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 整改有四步，要转成一个圈。

shots.scene: 老李在拆开的设备里找原因
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks for the root cause inside an opened equipment panel.
shots.narration: 先找到根本原因。

shots.scene: 老李更换零件，小研记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces a part while the female graduate student records it on a blank form.
shots.narration: 再采取纠正措施。

shots.scene: 一个月后小研回来复查，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Weeks later, the female graduate student returns to recheck the equipment and gives a green check.
shots.narration: 最后验证：问题真的不再发生。

shots.scene: 第四步图标缺失，问题图标又冒出来
shots.prompt_en: The fourth step icon is missing from the circle and the problem icon pops up again. No people.
shots.narration: 漏掉验证，问题就会反复。

shots.section_title: 按时回复，写明完成日期
shots.scene: 日历上圈出一个截止日期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a deadline date circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 收到检查意见，要按时回复。
overlay: 按时回复，写明完成日期

shots.section_title: 按时回复，写明完成日期
shots.scene: 空白整改回复单，每一项后有日期框
shots.prompt_en: A blank corrective response form with a date box after each item. No people.
shots.narration: 每项整改，都写明完成日期。

shots.section_title: 按时回复，写明完成日期
shots.scene: 拖延的蜗牛图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A snail icon representing delay, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 拖着不办、敷衍了事，后果更重。

shots.scene: 靶心图标，飞镖正中
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with a dart in the bullseye. No people.
shots.narration: 自己查出问题，不是失败是收获。

shots.scene: 趋势折线图，一类问题逐季上升
shots.prompt_en: A trend line chart where one type of finding rises each quarter. No people.
shots.narration: 把问题汇总看趋势。

shots.scene: 老周把空白趋势图交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank trend chart to the safety administrator in an office.
shots.narration: 比如培训记录老缺，就改培训系统。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个金色奖杯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a golden trophy.
shots.narration: 检查是帮手，不是负担。

shots.section_title: 成熟实验室的日常样子
shots.scene: 小研在电脑前几秒钟调出空白制度文件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank signed procedure document on a computer within seconds.
shots.narration: 制度现行有效、签批齐全、随时调出。
overlay: 成熟实验室的日常样子

shots.section_title: 成熟实验室的日常样子
shots.scene: 阿杰在操作考核中演示，王老师打分
shots.prompt_en: The young male student demonstrates a task while the safety administrator scores him on a blank form.
shots.narration: 培训记录要证明会做，不只签到。

shots.section_title: 成熟实验室的日常样子
shots.scene: 仪器上贴着空白的合格状态标牌
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a blank status tag showing it is checked and in service. No people.
shots.narration: 设备状态有效，标识清楚。

shots.section_title: 成熟实验室的日常样子
shots.scene: 空白险情报告单进入整改圆环
shots.prompt_en: A blank near-miss report icon entering the corrective action loop. No people.
shots.narration: 连险情也进入整改闭环。

shots.scene: 全组围坐，和检查老师一起讨论
shots.prompt_en: The lab group sits together and discusses openly with the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 把检查当成一起学习的机会。

shots.scene: 日历上每一天都打着小勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a small green check on every day. No people.
shots.narration: 突击检查来了，也平平常常。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着日历
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a big calendar.
shots.narration: 准备不是一次事件，是每天的状态。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标，每层旁有放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons of a university, a department and a laboratory, each with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 高校有校、院、实验室的定期检查。

shots.scene: 王老师手持空白检查项目表逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks items on a blank inspection checklist in a lab.
shots.narration: 上级部门也会按检查项目表来查。

shots.scene: 一排空白台账本：化学品、气瓶、废物、培训
shots.prompt_en: A row of blank ledger books with icons for chemicals, gas cylinders, waste and training. No people.
shots.narration: 平时就要把各类台账记好。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶上贴着标签，旁边一本空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank hazard label with pictograms, next to a blank safety data sheet booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品要一书一签，账物相符。

shots.scene: 门口的空白安全信息牌、灭火器和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety information sign at a lab door, with a fire extinguisher and an eyewash station nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 信息牌、消防和应急设施也要查。

shots.scene: 空白整改通知单上有日期和签名框
shots.prompt_en: A blank rectification notice with a date box and a signature box. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患要定人、定措施、定期限。

shots.scene: 一台仪器贴上停用标签，旁边禁止使用标志
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a blank out-of-service tag and a no-use prohibition sign. No people.
shots.narration: 重大隐患，先停用、停实验。

shots.scene: 王老师复查后在单子上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator rechecks the fixed item and signs the blank notice.
shots.narration: 整改完复查，合格再销号。

shots.scene: 小研如实回答检查人员的提问
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student answers a visitor's questions honestly, showing a blank record book.
shots.narration: 检查时如实说明，不知道就去查。

shots.scene: 补写旧日期的记录本图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand back-dating entries in a logbook, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不隐瞒，不补造记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰下班前关水龙头、检查电源
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, the young male student turns off a tap and checks that a power switch is off.
shots.narration: 每天离开前，自己查一遍。

shots.scene: 水、电、气、门窗四个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a water tap, a power plug, a gas valve and a window. No people.
shots.narration: 水电气关好，门窗锁好。

shots.scene: 阿杰在门口的空白登记本上签名离开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank logbook at the lab door and leaves.
shots.narration: 这就是每个人的日常节奏。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在日历和档案盒旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a calendar and an archive box.
shots.narration: 天天准备，检查就是彩排。

shots.scene: 档案盒和电脑图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an archive box and a computer. No people.
shots.narration: 记录分类保存，随时调得出。

shots.scene: 四个节点的时间轴图标
shots.prompt_en: A timeline icon with four nodes. No people.
shots.narration: 周巡、季查、外评、年度模拟。

shots.scene: 四步整改圆环图标
shots.prompt_en: A four-step loop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 找根因、去整改、验效果。

shots.scene: 台账本和整改单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ledger book and a rectification notice. No people.
shots.narration: 台账记好，隐患限期改，如实配合。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰在整洁的实验室挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student and the young male student in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 天天都准备好，下次见！
